ORDER
THIS MATTER comes before the Public Employee Labor Relations Board at its regularly
scheduled meeting on June 2, 2026, upon a request for interlocutory appeal pursuant to NMAC
11.21.1.27. After reviewing the record, hearing argument from the parties and their
representatives, and being otherwise sufficiently informed, the Board voted unanimously to deny
the request for interlocutory appeal. The hearing examiner is instructed to continue with the
processing of the Complaint pursuant to the Board’s procedural rules.
